name: June
source:
A mysterious girl the [url=/c165977]Officer[/url] met on the night of his musical debut. After the two shared a night of passion, June vanished the next morning without a word, just as suddenly as she appeared.

Although their encounter was short-lived, the Officer regards the time he shared with June as his last pleasant memory, a night that even now, in moments of weakness, he will sometimes relive.

[spoiler]June was the code name of [url=/c166045]Rose[/url] in the final months leading to the Day of Infamy. Her sudden lost of contact and sporadic mysterious reappearances compelled Hilde to form a pact with the Officer - the one Rose has an unexplained attachment to.[/spoiler]

[In-Game Description]
